scripts.backend:split: concurrently -n public,admin -c blue,magenta "npm run backend:public" "npm run backend:admin"
scripts.backend:kill-ports: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ports=@(8765,8766); foreach($p in $ports){ $pids=(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique); foreach($pid in $pids){ Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }"
scripts.backend:split:clean: npm run backend:kill-ports && npm run backend:split
scripts.frontend:user: set VITE_DEV_PORT=5173&& set VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:8765&& set VITE_ADMIN_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8766&& cd frontend && npm run dev -- --open /
scripts.frontend:admin: set VITE_DEV_PORT=5174&& set VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:8765&& set VITE_ADMIN_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8766&& cd frontend && npm run dev -- --open /admin.html
scripts.frontend:user:cloud: set VITE_DEV_PORT=5173&& set VITE_PUBLIC_API_BASE=https://api.keygent.xyz&& set VITE_ADMIN_API_BASE=https://admin-api.keygent.xyz&& cd frontend && npm run dev -- --open /
scripts.frontend:admin:cloud: set VITE_DEV_PORT=5174&& set VITE_PUBLIC_API_BASE=https://api.keygent.xyz&& set VITE_ADMIN_API_BASE=https://admin-api.keygent.xyz&& cd frontend && npm run dev -- --open /admin.html
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.beta:build-web:cloud: cross-env VITE_PUBLIC_API_BASE=https://api.keygent.xyz VITE_ADMIN_API_BASE=https://admin-api.keygent.xyz VITE_ELECTRON_FILE=1 npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.beta:desktop: npm install --prefix desktop && npm start --prefix desktop
scripts.beta:desktop:fresh: npm run beta:build-web && npm run beta:desktop
scripts.beta:bundle-backend: py -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt && py -m pip install -q pyinstaller && py -m PyInstaller --clean --noconfirm --distpath dist_py --workpath build_py desktop/pyinstaller/piano-backend.spec
scripts.beta:pack: npm run beta:build-web && npm run beta:bundle-backend && npm install --prefix desktop && npm run dist --prefix desktop
scripts.beta:pack:cloud: npm run beta:build-web:cloud && npm install --prefix desktop && npm run predist:cloud --prefix desktop && npm run dist:cloud --prefix desktop
